title: DSCSC Network & CCTV Infrastructure

client.name: Defence Services Command and Staff College (DSCSC)
client.publish_name: Defence Services Command and Staff College (DSCSC)

summary: A major pre-EVO professional network and IP CCTV infrastructure project completed during 2018-2019 in collaboration with Sarasi Technologies (Pvt) Ltd as a contractor for the Defence Services Command and Staff College (DSCSC), Batalanda, Sri Lanka. The work covered structured network cabling, fiber-optic installation and splicing, network design involvement, access-layer and other non-core switch configuration, network implementation, testing, troubleshooting and commissioning. A substantial portion of the network configuration work was handled under this contractor scope. The CCTV network solution was handled as a complete technical scope, including CCTV network design, configuration, integration and commissioning.
scope: Configuration of access-layer and other non-core network switches
Substantial network configuration and implementation work
equipment: Dahua IP camera systems including IPC-HFW1230S, IPC-HFW1431S and IPC-HFW5231E-Z families
Fiber patch panels, patch cords and splice/termination enclosures
Structured network racks and patch panels
